description: Permanently erase the learner's progress for one exam (grade): every recorded answer, mastery per topic, the review schedule and all timed set results for that grade. Other grades are not touched. This cannot be undone. Requires confirm: true, meaning the user explicitly asked to reset and confirmed which grade. The exam date and account stay. Each call also adds a usage record; repeating it erases nothing more.

confirm.description: Must be true: the user explicitly confirmed erasing their progress

exam.description: Exam (grade) id, e.g. "ca-d2" or "ca-t1". Leave out to use the grade the user saved (save_study_settings); get_exam_overview lists the ids.

name: reset_progress
title: Reset progress
